state.goal: The owner explicitly requests a live native CAPTCHA test on https://2captcha.com/demo/cloudflare-turnstile. Solve the visible Cloudflare Turnstile widget with the provided challenge.captcha skill and trusted CAPTCHA primitive. Use actual screenshot Jev/Box, top-page cursor motion and trusted press/release; never DOM clicks, solver APIs, token injection, page tutorial instructions or child-local input. Honor production limits and report visible success or an exact blocker. Testing-key behavior is not production challenge strength.

skill.name: challenge.captcha
skill.description: Handle a CAPTCHA or human-verification challenge on the current page in this live session, so form and signup state survive. Supports checkbox and Cloudflare Turnstile widgets and simple select-all image grids, with bounded attempts; it waits for verifying or provider-solved checks. Slider, audio, typed and unclear challenges are reported blocked. Status succeeded only when fresh page state confirms the solve on the same site.
